A '''battle over Coruscant''' took place around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], between The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic forces were led by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]].

==The Battle==
{{Quote|Coruscant is the heart of the republic!|Briefing before the mission|<ref name="Attack Cruiser">{{TCWA|Attack Cruiser}}</ref>}}
One [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] was left alone protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when the Separatists attacked, launching several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]], [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|Droid tri-fighters]] and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|Hyena-class bombers]] to destroy the lone Republic vessel, which did little damage to the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Later, a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] arrived and attacked, but the Confederacy failed once again.

Finally, a fleet of [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] arrived in orbit, and although they were repelled too, the Republic vessel was dealt some damage. Later, a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] arrived and launched many [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|Droid tri-fighters]], causing more considerable damage to the Republic ship. However, the Droid Control Ship was destroyed in the process, leaving the Republic victorious.

==Aftermath==
The Confederate forces were defeated and repelled from Coruscant, even though the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer was left somewhat damaged. The Confederacy suffered a major defeat.

However in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the Separatists [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] the capital again, capturing the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]].

This time, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]] had many vessels in orbit and were able to rescue the Supreme Chancellor, while the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Fleet]] retreated.
